reasons: Sentence 2 mostly repeats sentence 1: '기록하고 분석하는 도구' and then '상호작용을 캡처하여 통계와 품질 점수를 보여줍니다'. The second sentence adds only the stats and scores.
'상호작용을 캡처하여' is translationese (a literal 'captures every interaction'). A native writer would say '기록해' or '자동으로 모아'.
The opening sentence's subject is a bare category label ('...도구입니다'). The product name only appears in sentence 2.
what_author_would_change: Merge into one natural sentence, e.g. 'Oh My Prompt는 Claude Code·Codex 등에 보낸 프롬프트를 자동으로 기록해 품질 점수와 사용 통계로 보여 주는 셀프호스팅 도구입니다.'

reasons: 'Running hundreds of prompts a day to AI coding agents?' is unidiomatic. You send or write prompts to an agent; you don't 'run' prompts to it.
'turns them into searchable analytics' is a vague label. It leaves out the concrete value in the source: a quality score for each prompt, token/session stats, and a self-hosted dashboard plus CLI.
The rhetorical-question opener reads as ad copy lifted from the README's 'Why?' section.
what_author_would_change: Fix the verb, and say what you actually get: 'Oh My Prompt records every prompt you send to Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI, scores its quality, and shows usage patterns in a self-hosted dashboard.'

reasons: Sentence 1 has no subject: '...기본 로그인을 건드리지 않고 세션을 따로 실행합니다' does not say who runs the session. The name 'aas' only arrives in sentence 2.
'명령어로 즉시 전환합니다' has no object (전환 what? 계정을).
A first-time reader can't tell from the opening that this is a CLI tool.
what_author_would_change: Lead with the subject and objects, e.g. 'aas는 Claude Code·Codex 계정 여러 개를 명령 하나로 전환하고, 기본 로그인은 그대로 둔 채 다른 계정으로 세션을 띄우며, 계정별 남은 사용량을 한눈에 보여 주는 CLI입니다.'

reasons: Sentence 1 has no subject: '...직접 사용하게 할 수 있습니다' says 'can' without saying who can or what can. It reads as a capability pitch rather than a description.
'입력과 조작을 수행하며' is stiff translationese (a literal 'clicks and types'). '수행하다' is a noun-plus-verb construction a native writer would avoid.

It says the work is saved as a Flow but never says why. The key benefit in the source is replaying with new inputs and no model call, and it is missing, so 'Flow로 저장합니다' means nothing to a first-time reader.
what_author_would_change: 'Haejo는 Claude와 Codex가 Mac·브라우저 앱을 대신 열고 클릭하고 입력한 뒤 결과까지 확인하게 해 줍니다. 한 번 한 작업은 Flow로 저장돼, 다음엔 새 입력만 넣으면 모델 호출 없이 다시 실행됩니다.'

reasons: 'use your Mac and browser apps to open interfaces, click controls, and enter information' is awkward. It literally says the apps are used to open interfaces. 'open interfaces' and 'click controls' are jargon taken from the README's computer-use explanation.
The pronoun in 'so you can run it again' has no clear antecedent: it could be 'the steps' (plural) or 'a reusable Flow'.
The distinctive 'checks the result before calling a task done' is dropped. This is minor on its own.
what_author_would_change: 'Haejo lets Claude and Codex use your Mac and browser apps for you: it opens apps, clicks, types, and checks the result. The steps are saved as a Flow you can rerun with new inputs and no model call.'

reasons: '해당 창으로 바로 이동시킵니다' has no object (who or what is moved?). '이동시키다' is also awkward here; it should be something like '바로 그 pane으로 이동할 수 있게 해 줍니다'.
In Korean tmux usage '창' means a window, but Tend jumps to the agent's pane. That is a factual and terminology mismatch.
'입력이나 답변을 기다리는지' is redundant, since the agent's 답변 wait is itself waiting for input. The source says input, a choice, or an error, and errors are left out.
'상태를 감지하여' and '해당' are stiff, written-report register.
what_author_would_change: 'tmux에서 코딩 에이전트를 여러 개 돌리면 어느 쪽이 내 입력을 기다리는지 놓치기 쉽습니다. Tend는 이미 실행 중인 Claude Code·Codex 세션을 지켜보다가 입력이나 선택을 기다리거나 오류로 멈추면 알려 주고, 그 pane으로 바로 데려다줍니다.'

reasons: Factual mistake: '메뉴바와 데스크톱에서 위젯과 도구를 하나의 팝오버로 정리해' merges two separate features. The popover belongs to the menu bar icon, and desktop placement is a macOS desktop widget, not a popover.
The opener '...모으고 싶을 때가 있습니다' is a generic filler hook, and '작은 아이콘 하나로 모으고' is fuzzy (모은다 into an icon).
It never says this is a free, native macOS app. '위젯과 도구' is a vague label, and the distinctive 'any command that emits JSON becomes a widget' is reduced to '스크립트와 명령어 출력'.
what_author_would_change: 'BarShelf는 날씨, 달력, 시스템 상태, 비밀번호, 사용량을 메뉴바 아이콘 하나 뒤로 모아 주는 macOS 앱입니다. JSON을 내는 명령이면 무엇이든 위젯으로 만들 수 있습니다.'

reasons: 'Your menu bar holds a dozen tiny icons, browser tabs, and terminal windows' is false: a menu bar does not hold browser tabs or terminal windows. It misreads the homepage line, which says these tools are spread 'across a row of tiny icons, browser tabs, and terminal windows'.
'custom CLI outputs' is slightly off. The source says any command that emits JSON is rendered as a native widget.
what_author_would_change: 'Glanceable stuff ends up scattered across menu bar icons, browser tabs, and terminal windows. BarShelf puts weather, system stats, passwords, usage meters, and any JSON-emitting command behind one native macOS menu bar icon.'
